title: Beetle Alchemist
description: A large anthropomorphic beetle with multiple arms stands atop a mound of smaller beetles and human hands emerging from the pile. The beetle wears a crown and goggles, holds various alchemical tools including glowing rings, a lantern, and an open book while surrounded by floating symbols and mathematical diagrams.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal illustration of a large multi-armed anthropomorphic beetle wearing a crown and goggles, standing on a mound of smaller beetles and human hands reaching upward. The beetle holds glowing rings, a lantern, and an open book. Floating around it are mathematical equations, geometric diagrams, and occult symbols against a smoky dark background with bokeh light effects.
